summary_en: Interim dividend of ¥47 per share confirmed as previously guided for fiscal year ending March 2027. Year-end dividend forecast raised by ¥10 to ¥60 per share, bringing full-year dividend to ¥107 per share. Dividend payout target (DOE) raised from 3.6% to 4.0%, reflecting upward ROE guidance from 9% to over 9%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Interim Dividend Allocation, Revision of Year-end Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase), and Change in Shareholder Return Indicator Target
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, Nippon Rietec's board of directors confirmed the interim dividend at ¥47 per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, maintaining the guidance announced on May 12, 2026. The company simultaneously raised its year-end dividend forecast by ¥10 to ¥60 per share, resulting in a full-year dividend of ¥107 per share, compared to ¥82 per share in the prior fiscal year.

The company also revised upward its shareholder return target indicator, known as DOE (Dividend on Equity), from 3.6% to 4.0%. This adjustment reflects the upward revision of earnings forecasts disclosed separately on the same day. Under the company's capital allocation framework, DOE is calculated as the product of ROE (Return on Equity) and dividend payout ratio. The target ROE was increased from 9% to over 9%, while the dividend payout ratio remains fixed at 40%, resulting in the higher DOE target of 4.0%.

The company positions stable dividend continuation and opportunistic share repurchases as core pillars of shareholder returns, seeking to balance steady, progressive dividend increases with improved capital efficiency. The company does not rely on short-term earnings fluctuations in setting its dividend policy.
